title.from: References include: three selections, Reference cards, page-level de-duplication, twin line
title.to: References include: three selections, Reference cards with Cyclotron confidence, page-level de-duplication, twin line

description.from:
Phase 2 of the `wire` epic. The Reference grid component, three selections, page-level de-duplication, Markdown twin behaviour.

## Goal
`::include{kind="references" select="recent|confident|recommended" count="6" [section="articles"] [card="tile|row"] [heading="..."] [more="/path/"]}` renders a grid of Reference cards from `_data/wire/references.json` at projection time. Several includes on one page never show the same Reference twice; the first wins.

## Files to create
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/wire.py`: `WireSource` modelled on `knowledge.py` `KnowledgeSource` (`attach_store(reader)`, `use_directory(path)`, `references() -> dict | None`, `digest() -> str` over the file bytes, `configured()`).
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/wire_blocks.py`: `ATTRIBUTES = {"select", "count", "section", "card", "heading", "more", "empty"}`; `check(attributes, source)` (select required and one of three; count a whole number; card one of `tile`, `row`; `more` passes `safe_href`); `select_references(document, attributes, ledger) -> list[dict]`; `render(attributes, source_doc, ledger, settings) -> str`; `is_wire_include(attributes)`.
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/wire_components.py`: card markup. `tile`: image (if present) with `alt=""`, host as eyebrow, title linking to `url` (`rel="noopener"`), `sourceDate` and `acceptedAt` as `<time>`, section chip, for `recommended` a status chip "Recommended, not yet accepted" with a Lucide `sparkles` inline SVG (text + icon, never colour alone), confidence as "93% confidence" text plus a Lucide `gauge` icon when the field is present. `row`: one line (host, title, date). Flat background tones and rounded rectangles only: no borders, no hairlines (classes `wire-grid`, `wire-tile`, `wire-row`, `wire-chip`; styles in `assets/papyrus-wire.css`, shipped like `papyrus-knowledge.css`).
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/page_ledger.py`: `PageLedger` with `seen: set[str]`, `claim(key) -> bool`. One instance per page render.
- `features_backend/wire-references.feature` + steps; fixture site `features_backend/fixtures/standard-site/wire/` (projection.json with `wire`, a `pages/front.md` with three includes, `_data/wire/references.json` copied from the snapshot fixture).

## Files to change
- `standard/includes.py`: accept `kind="references"` in `check()`; `include_inputs()` records `[dict(attributes), "wire:references"]` so the page digest changes when attributes change (the data digest is folded in by the projector).
- `standard/projector.py`: hold `self._wire = WireSource()`; `attach_store` and a `use_wire_directory`; `_wire_inputs(found)` returns `[self._wire.digest()]` when any include is a wire include, added to the custom-page, home, section-index and 404 digest inputs next to `*self._knowledge_inputs(found)`; `_include()` dispatches `kind == "references"` to `wire_blocks.render(attributes, self._wire.references(), page.ledger, self.standard.wire)`; create `page.ledger = PageLedger()` in `_page()` so every include on that page shares it. If `standard.wire` is None, a wire include is a build error naming the file ("wire is not configured in projection.json").
- `standard/page.py`: `StandardPage` gains `ledger`.
- `standard/blocks.py` `twin()`: keep `::include` lines whose `kind` is `references` (or `threads`) as written, as it does for knowledge blocks; extend `_knowledge_block()` into `_kept_include()`.
- `standard/markdown.py` / `_markdown_for`: nothing else; the twin line is the agent-readable form.
- `standard/assets/papyrus-wire.css`: new stylesheet, included by `head.py` only when `standard.wire` is set (same gate as the knowledge CSS).
- `standard/config.py`: reject a `pages[].path`, section `base` or collection `base` equal to a reserved prefix (`_data`, `_plugins`, `_papyrus`, `_next`, `api`) with a message that also says `newsroom` is reserved on CMS-style edges (see epic).

## Selection and ordering (exact)
- `recent`: `status == accepted`, sort by `acceptedAt` desc, then `arrivedAt` desc, then `key` asc.
- `confident`: `status == accepted`, sort by `confidence` desc (missing = 0.5), then `arrivedAt` desc, then `key` asc.
- `recommended`: `status == recommended`, sort by `confidence` desc, then `arrivedAt` desc, then `key` asc.
- `section="X"` keeps entries whose `section` equals the section's label or name.
- De-duplication: iterate in order, `if ledger.claim("reference:" + key)` append, stop at `count`. `count` is required (no default), so every page states its own numbers.
- `empty="..."` text renders when nothing is left; otherwise the include renders nothing and the page keeps its own heading.

## Gherkin scenarios (features_backend/wire-references.feature)
- "A page places the six most recently accepted References as tiles"
- "A page ranks accepted References by Cyclotron confidence"
- "A page shows recommended References labelled as not yet accepted, in text and icon"
- "Three components on one page never repeat a Reference; the first component wins"
- "A later component refills to its count from its own ordering after skipping"
- "A section attribute keeps only that section's References"
- "A Story listing and Reference grids interleave in document order on one authored page"
- "The Markdown twin keeps the references include line as written"
- "A wire include on a site without wire configured fails the build naming the file"
- "A changed snapshot re-renders only the pages that place a references include" (shared with the snapshot feature)
- "A page path equal to a reserved prefix fails the build"
- "Wire cards have no borders and show state in text and icon, not colour alone" (assert the CSS has no `border:` other than `border-radius`/`border: 0`, and the recommended chip contains text)

## Acceptance checks
- Unit tests for selection, de-duplication and the probability port; behave green.
- Build the fixture site to a directory (`papyrus project --static-dir ... --out ...`) and open `front/index.html` and `front/index.md`; confirm the twin keeps the include lines.

## Dependencies
Depends on: wire snapshot (fixture file and settings). Blocks: Anth.us section, section fronts, threads.
